```javascript
import events from './events.json' with {type:'json'};

const TOOLS = [
  {
    name: 'events_list',
    description: 'List events with pagination.',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        cursor: { type: 'string' },
        page_size: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 3 }
      },
      additionalProperties: false
    }
  }
];

const VALID_FIELDS = new Set(['cursor', 'page_size']);

function encodeCursor(offset) {
  return Buffer.from(`offset:${offset}`).toString('base64');
}

function decodeCursor(cursor) {
  let decoded;
  try {
    decoded = Buffer.from(cursor, 'base64').toString('utf8');
  } catch {
    throw new Error('Invalid cursor');
  }
  const match = decoded.match(/^offset:(\d+)$/);
  if (!match) throw new Error('Invalid cursor');
  const offset = parseInt(match[1], 10);
  if (!Number.isInteger(offset) || offset < 0 || offset > events.length) {
    throw new Error('Invalid cursor');
  }
  return offset;
}

export async function listTools() {
  return TOOLS;
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'events_list') {
    throw new Error('Unknown tool');
  }
  
  // Validate no extra fields
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!VALID_FIELDS.has(key)) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown field: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  
  let offset = 0;
  if (args.cursor !== undefined) {
    if (typeof args.cursor !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('cursor must be a string');
    }
    offset = decodeCursor(args.cursor);
  }
  
  let pageSize = 2;
  if (args.page_size !== undefined) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(args.page_size) || args.page_size < 1 || args.page_size > 3) {
      throw new Error('page_size must be an integer between 1 and 3');
    }
    pageSize = args.page_size;
  }
  
  const slice = events.slice(offset, offset + pageSize);
  const nextOffset = offset + slice.length;
  const nextCursor = nextOffset < events.length ? encodeCursor(nextOffset) : null;
  
  return {
    content: [
      {
        type: 'text',
        text: JSON.stringify({ events: slice, next_cursor: nextCursor })
      }
    ]
  };
}
```
